The '''Gungan Security Force''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that was used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] race to police their society. [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Huff Zinga]] ultimately handed over the irresponsible janitor [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to the security force, who in turn delivered him to [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] after an incident in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] at the [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility]].
